messages:
emma.s: Quick heads-up — BrightLeaf POC is blocked on procurement. They returned MSA + DPA redlines and want a PO before we stand up any dedicated capacity. Also asking for a 3rd-party escrow clause and a custom SLA around throughput. Can legal/finance weigh in?

marco.se: For the POC we can meet their throughput SLA if they select a small dedicated pool. p99 < 300ms at ~100 rps is realistic. I can put a tech appendix in the order form with measured numbers.

priya.eng: FYI, if they stream responses we'll need prefix caching enabled; that impacts cost. Need rough token estimate from Sales to finalize pricing.

daniel.legal: Send over their redlines. Major legal asks? If they're trying to remove our liability cap that's a hard no without exec approval. DPA + EU SCCs is OK but needs legal review — route it to enterprise legal.

claire.finance: Procurement wants NET30 and a standard PO. Our default for new enterprise is NET45, but we can approve NET30 for a limited POC if they prepay credits. Do we have prepay?

emma.s: They explicitly said no prepay. Asking us to accept a PO + NET30. Is there an exec sign-off path to make an exception?

daniel.legal: Exec exception is possible but needs written approval. Proposed flow: 1) Sales confirms commercial terms inline; 2) Legal posts MSA redline and gets countersign; 3) Finance issues invoice; 4) Order form signed via DocuSign — prefer sequential sign where MSA executes before provisioning.

sec-bot: Security questionnaire submitted by BrightLeaf (ID BL-882): https://sec.example.com/q/BL-882 — auto-flag: data retention controls (item 6.5) require DPO confirmation.

priya.eng: For the DPA — they require EU-only storage. We can support in eu-west-1 (VPC private deployment). Need explicit field in the order form: deployment_region=eu-west-1. Also confirm retention TTL — what's the ask?

emma.s: They want 30 day ephemeral logs, 12 month storage for customer artifacts. Is that acceptable?

priya.eng: 30 days for logs + 12 months for artifacts is doable. We'll note it in the DPA answers.

marco.se: Draft order form snippet below (to paste into the invoice/order form):
```
PO_NUMBER: BL-PO-2026-07
BILL_TO: procurement@brightleaf.com
NET_TERMS: 30
MODEL: redwood-7b-quant
REGION: eu-west-1
PREPAY_CREDITS: 0
PO_SCAN_REQUIRED: yes
```

emma.s: Tagging @daniel.legal and @claire.finance — need signature routing advice. They want countersignature only after MSA. Can we do parallel signatures on order form + MSA?

daniel.legal: Parallel signature OK if we include an effective-date clause: "Agreement effective upon last signature." I'll add that to the redline so neither party can claim partial execution. Drafting now and will post link.

claire.finance: If Sales accepts NET30, Finance will prepare invoice and send to billing contact in PO. We need scanned PO before provisioning. If legal signs later, finance will hold provisioning until we confirm receipt or we can provision sandbox only.

marco.se: We can provision a sandbox account (no dedicated GPUs) pre-payment so they can start integration. Sandbox access requires a signed NDA + access request; I can send invite once I see a scanned PO.

emma.s: Action items (copying for clarity):
- daniel.legal -> upload redlined MSA + clause for signature/effective date
- claire.finance -> prepare invoice and note NET30; request scanned PO
- marco.se -> create sandbox onboarding checklist + invite once PO scan present
- priya.eng -> finalize DPA answers and region/retention confirmation

Any objections? :thumbsup:

daniel.legal: Uploaded redline here: https://docs.redwood/legal/redlines/BL-MSA-1802356789 — please review and comment by EOD.

marco.se: I'll hold the sandbox invite until I get the PO scan. If Sales wants me to push earlier I can, but it'll be limited access.

claire.finance: Acknowledged. I'll draft invoice and email the billing contact from the PO once we get the scanned copy.

emma.s: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source. Will follow up once legal posts final redline.
